title: Apple's MacBook Neo uses an A18 Pro that launched in the iPhone 16 lineup, alongside 8BM of RAM and a headphone jack; Apple discontinued the 12" MacBook in 2019 (Stevie Bonifield/The Verge)
summary: Stevie Bonifield / The Verge: Apple's MacBook Neo uses an A18 Pro that launched in the iPhone 16 lineup, alongside 8BM of RAM and a headphone jack; Apple discontinued the 12" MacBook in 2019 — The entry-level MacBook could help Apple compete with Chromebooks and low-cost Windows laptops.
